description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
